output_list.criticism: The function _transfer has an integer overflow vulnerability. The operation balanceOf[_from] -= _value can overflow if _value is sufficiently large, causing totalSupply and balanceOf[target] to be set to a small value, and allowing attackers to mint arbitrary amounts of tokens.

The constructor of the contract is public, making it vulnerable to front-running attacks. An attacker can call the constructor of this contract to get the owner's address before the contract is even deployed, and then use the constructor to set up the owner as msg.sender, which is the address that can mint additional tokens.
